title: Instruction Hierarchy Violation Benchmark: Measuring Whether Models Correctly Prioritize System vs. User vs. Tool Prompts

original_idea.quick_reasoning: Clearly addresses an AI Safety problem with a reasonably scoped approach.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Instruction hierarchy enforcement is foundational to deployed LLM safety. If users or tool outputs can override system prompts, operator-level safety is meaningless. A benchmark validating this is critically needed.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Test case creation involves crafting conflicting prompts at three levels -- conceptually straightforward. API-only, no GPU needed. Evaluation requires judging which instruction the model followed, which can be automated. Beginner-accessible.

narrow_scope.reasoning: 60-90 test cases across 3 conflict types and 3 models is moderate. Designing realistic multi-level conflicts requires careful thought. The 3-level structure adds complexity. Feasible in 30 hours if scoped to 40-50 test cases.
